items.description: A persistence implementation may overwrite a current-state record and lose lifecycle history.
items.mitigation: Persist immutable entries and verify multi-entry history plus order/hash metadata through export.

items.description: Maker-checker validation may trust the current command actor instead of the durable proposer.
items.mitigation: Compare the checker to proposer identity loaded from persisted proposal history.

items.description: Non-atomic file or database writes may allow simultaneous approve and reject decisions.
items.mitigation: Use an atomic conditional append/transaction and test true concurrent processes.

items.description: Generic object serialization or exception logging may leak synthetic account or amount fields.
items.mitigation: Use explicit allow-listed DTOs and scan all command output and export for sentinels.
